witness.quote: When official traffic-control devices are erected giving notice thereof
witness.reason: The broad road layout permits a controlled-access highway entry connection without changing the fixed entry intent or device control, but this additional status and geometry require support.
required_context: Actual supported entry connection onto a controlled-access highway; generic road geometry does not establish that status.
Device identity, applicable instructions, official placement and notice of indicated entrances.
Establish a supported entry route, vehicle eligibility and actual driving activity.
Establish controlled-access status through the relevant public authority's jurisdiction and determination of access points and manner, including the absence of other legal access rights.
Establish device content, notice, indicated entrances and exits, official placement and relevant legal status.
Establish highway dedication, public vehicular use and entire boundary-to-boundary extent.
Motor-vehicle route eligibility, qualifying vehicle and actual driving activity.
Public-authority access determination, highway dedication, public use and entire highway boundaries.
Record the actual entry path relative to highway boundaries and indicated entrances without inventing a statutory vehicle-footprint crossing rule.
